name: 热处理（自动化/控温/记录）

map.选择钢种与工艺，自动获取温度区间，计算保温时间并记录控温曲线。: Select the steel grade and process to auto-obtain the temperature range, calculate the holding time and record the temperature-control curve.
map.📖 查看「热处理控温记录使用指南」: 📖 View the "Heat-Treatment Temperature-Control Record User Guide"
map.保温时间 t = k·δ + 20（分钟）；δ 为工件有效厚度(mm)，k 为工: Holding time t = k·δ + 20 (min); δ is the effective workpiece thickness (mm), k is the process coefficient; the reference temperature takes the midpoint of the material-process range T = (T_min + T_max)/2
map.渗碳工艺按渗层深度估算（约 0.12~0.15 mm/h），保温时间随渗层深度确: The carburizing process is estimated by case depth (about 0.12-0.15 mm/h); the holding time is set by the case depth; k is determined by the steel grade and process, used to ensure the core reaches temperature and the structure is uniform. The target temperature can be taken as the range midpoint with one click.
map.保温时间为估算值：保温时间 ≈ 有效厚度 × 系数 K，K 因工艺与材质而异（退: The holding time is an estimate: holding time ≈ effective thickness × coefficient K, where K varies by process and material (annealing 1.8, normalizing 1.2, quenching 1.0-1.5, tempering 2.0 min/mm)
map.渗碳时间按渗层深度估算（约 0.12~0.15 mm/h），仅作工艺参考: Carburizing time is estimated by case depth (about 0.12-0.15 mm/h) and is for process reference only
map.钢种工艺温度数据来源于常用热处理手册，实际应以材料质保书与工艺规程为准: Steel-grade process-temperature data comes from common heat-treatment manuals; in practice it should follow the material certificate and process specification
map.所有记录保存在浏览器本地，不会上传服务器: All records are saved locally in the browser and are not uploaded to any server
map.📚 深度解析：热处理（自动化/控温/记录）: 📚 In-depth: Heat Treatment (Automation / Temperature Control / Recording)
map.按钢种与工艺查询参考加热温度区间。: Query the reference heating-temperature range by steel grade and process.
map.估算保温时间并记录热处理曲线。: Estimate the holding time and record the heat-treatment curve.
map.按钢种与工艺自动给出参考温度区间并取中值，保温时间按有效厚度估算，便于设定炉温程: Auto-give the reference temperature range by steel grade and process and take the midpoint; the holding time is estimated by effective thickness, easing furnace-program setting.
map.渗碳保温时间按渗层深度估算（约 0.12~0.15 mm/h），而非按工件厚度确: Carburizing holding time is estimated by case depth (about 0.12-0.15 mm/h), not by the workpiece thickness.
map.保温时间为什么与厚度相关？: Why is the holding time related to thickness?
map.热量需从表面传到心部，有效厚度越大，到温与组织均匀所需时间越长。: Heat must transfer from the surface to the core; the greater the effective thickness, the longer it takes to reach temperature and homogenize the structure.
map.工艺记录有什么用？: What is the process record for?
map.用于质量追溯与客户审核，证明热处理按规程执行、温度时间在控。: It is used for quality traceability and customer audits, proving that heat treatment is performed per the specification with temperature and time under control.
map.面向热处理车间的控温记录工具，内置常用钢种退火/正火/淬火/回火/渗碳工艺温度区: A temperature-control recording tool for heat-treatment shops, with built-in annealing/normalizing/quenching/tempering/carburizing process-temperature ranges for common steel grades; it auto-computes holding time, records temperature in real time and plots the process curve.
map.内置 12 种常用钢种工艺温度: Built-in process temperatures for 12 common steel grades
E.g.: furnace loading, soaking, furnace unloading...
